turns.speaker: user
turns.text: Honestly, a little stressed, but okay.

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: At the end of interviews they always ask if I have questions, and I never do.

turns.speaker: moshi
turns.text: Let's fix that. Would you rather ask about the team and daily work, or about growth and where the role leads?

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: Hang tight, my dad is calling me over. Don't talk until I say I'm back.

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: Is your phone ringing or is that mine?

turns.speaker: friend
turns.text: That's yours, it's buzzing on the table.

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: Nina, do you want to do the raid tonight?

turns.speaker: friend
turns.text: What time? I've got work early tomorrow.

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: Like eight? It should only take a couple of hours.

turns.speaker: friend
turns.text: Last time you said that we finished at one in the morning.

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: That was because the tank kept disconnecting. We've got a new one now.

turns.speaker: friend
turns.text: Fine. Eight, and I'm out by ten whatever happens.

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: Deal. I'll send everyone a message.

turns.speaker: moshi
turns.text: Sure thing. You were choosing whether to ask about the team or about growth.

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: Growth. I don't want to be stuck in the same spot.

turns.speaker: moshi
turns.text: Then ask what success looks like after the first year, and how people in this role usually move up.
